about_the_game:
The story of a little girl named Maja, who meets a talking cat named Benny in the forest. Where did he come from? You will find out in time. The two heroes end up in a mysterious town. It turns out that... the trees there can talk, as can the bear and the paper lion.

The people they meet have different dreams and wishes, and not everything seems to be as it should be. The windmill dreams of wind - but where and how to find the wind? The hamster dreams of a sunflower and a spinning wheel, and the seal dreams of a ball. Where did the seal come from? Good question!

In the town, Maja and Benny will meet many different people (including a busy mathematician and a lost little boy), many animals, as well as many... other characters from whom they would not expect to be alive and talking. Because can a bicycle talk? Or a house? Apparently yes.

Will Maja and Benny discover the secret of the town? This will require them to not only get to know different places in the town and its inhabitants, but that is not all. There is also a snowy land, an underwater world, a desert and a distant planet to discover (a spacesuit would come in handy, right? A little hint: someone in the town knows something about it). And these are just some of their adventures.

As the action progresses, you will meet new characters and learn more about Maja and Benny. Will you be able to successfully complete all the missions, discover all the secrets and help all the heroes? Let's hope so.

So get to know Maja and Benny better, help the townspeople (but is it really only them?), and explore different lands and worlds. So help the lovely girl and her cat solve mysteries and logical puzzles and reach the destination of their exciting journey. Good luck!
